svg.title: System overview: face liveness in the MOSIP Registration Clients
svg.text: System overview: face liveness in the MOSIP Registration Clients
One engine on two clients. Liveness and PAD (Presentation Attack Detection) run on the device, online or offline.
Online only. Every check below runs the same without it.
MOSIP server: configuration sync, and registration packets that carry the audit records
Any static HTTPS host (off by default)
latest.json and a signed bundle zip
The same Java code on both clients
Builds the engine, opens the device
SFace: the stored face is the live face
SFace: the stored face is the live face
FrameSource interface: every source gives the engine the same Frame (pixels, timestamp, sequence, device id)
Reads and decodes the MJPEG (Motion JPEG) stream
Webcam, recorded video or still images
YUV to RGB, turned upright, paced to 15 frames a second
Laptop webcam, recordings, or the MockMDS
Camera for liveness frames. The SBI app’s capture intent
Limit: nothing was run against real L0/L1 hardware or a live MOSIP backend. In tests, a webcam or phone camera stands in.
